question: The ratio between the perimeter and breadth of a rectangle is 3 : 1. If the area of the rectangle is 98 cm², find the perimeter (in cm) of the rectangle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Perimeter** (2(L+B)) to **Breadth** (B) is 3 : 1.

⇒ 2L + 2B = 3B ⇒ 2L = B

Since Area = L × B = 98 ⇒ L × 2L = 98 ⇒ 2L² = 98 ⇒ L² = 49 ⇒ L = 7 cm.

Then B = 2 × 7 = 14 cm.

Perimeter = 2(7 + 14) = 2 × 21 = 42 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/927dffd0219a3a165ff1294675687e4f0030184627b927c61bb15e014f7433b2.png] 

**Given:**

Ratio of **Perimeter** to **Breadth** = 3 : 1

**Area of Rectangle** = 98 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter = 2(L + B)

Area = L × B

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2(L + B) / B = 3 / 1

⇒ 2L + 2B = 3B

⇒ 2L = B

⇒ Area = L × B = 98

⇒ L × (2L) = 98

⇒ 2L² = 98

⇒ L² = 49

⇒ L = 7 cm

⇒ B = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2(7 + 14) = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Diagonals are equal and bisect each other.

Diagonal Formula

The length of the diagonal (d) of a rectangle is given by d = √(L² + B²).

Square as a Rectangle

A square is a special case of a rectangle where all four sides are equal (L = B).</p
